Restoration failure already records a cleanup error. Preserve the first primary failure and existing re-raise path independently: cleanup=success must never convert injected failure into exit zero.

Initialize a fixed scalar first_signal=null in state. At existing receipt finalization after handler restoration, copy received.signal as its numeric signal identity, or null if none. Use the handler's actual observation, never the scenario name or intended signal. Preserve the existing first-only received.signal behavior and separate cleanup_interrupted flag. A deliberately raised KeyboardInterrupt is not an observed OS signal.

In the existing sole permitted killpg branch, capture the current phase into signal_attempt.phase immediately before the call, alongside unchanged intended/attempted/result semantics. Attempted group signals must record owned; no-attempt paths retain null. Do not infer the phase afterward from final reap state.
